  lora:
    rank: 0

imm:
  enabled: true

acis:

  action_dim: 720            # Expert hidden dim
  num_heads: 8
  dropout: 0.0

  # Full FT 100K checkpoint (update path when training completes)
  baseline_checkpoint: "checkpoints/libero_full_ft_50k/checkpoint.pt"
  stage1_steps: 10000        # Train ACIS on frozen expert features
